Package index

Computing and reading the graphs

vp_generate()
Compute the strong dependency and conflict graphs of a variability model
vp_classify()
Classify the variables of a formula without computing any graph
vp_history()
Compute the graphs of every version of a model
vp_example()
The example models that come with the package
vp_functions()
Every function of the package, by topic
vp_expand()
The complete graphs rebuilt from the minimal form
vp_features()
The features and their status (variable, core, dead)
vp_igraph()
The igraph object of one graph
vp_links()
The links of one graph, as a tibble
vp_minimal()
The minimal form: what was written, roughly
vp_read()
Read the files of one run of Strong4VM
vp_read_history()
Read several runs: the versions of a model
vp_read_uvl_tree()
The feature tree of a UVL model
vp_representativeness()
The share of the configurations the graphs allow that are valid (GANAK)
vp_subset()
Focus on part of a model (exact: no solver needed)
print(<vp_model>)
Print a model

Measuring each feature

vp_atleastone_of()
What leaving a feature out forces
vp_conflicts_of()
What a feature excludes
vp_feature_table()
Every measure of every feature, one row each
vp_genuine_hubs()
The most required features, and whether that is their own merit
vp_required_by()
What requires a feature (its impact set)
vp_requirements()
What a feature requires
vp_warning_zone()
Features both highly required and highly dependent

Layers and hierarchy

vp_atomic_sets()
Features always selected together
vp_chains()
The fewest chains that cover all features
vp_common_dependants()
What needs both of two features
vp_common_requirements()
What two features both need
vp_depth()
The length of the longest chain of requirements
vp_downset()
What depends on some features
vp_false_optional()
Optional features that are not really optional
vp_feature_tree()
A feature tree rebuilt from the skeleton
vp_foundations()
Features that need nothing
vp_implied_requires()
The arrows that follow from others, and through what
vp_largest_free_set()
The most features that are pairwise free (all three graphs)
vp_largest_unrelated_set()
One such set
vp_leaves()
Features that nothing needs
vp_levels()
The layer of each feature
vp_longest_chain()
One longest chain
vp_longest_decision_chain()
The longest chain of forced decisions (all three graphs)
vp_redundant_candidates()
Written requirements that follow from others
vp_skeleton()
The arrows that do not follow from others
vp_tree_agreement()
Does the declared tree hide layers of requirements?
vp_upset()
What some features bring along
vp_width()
The largest number of features none of which requires another

The whole model

vp_check()
Are the files consistent?
vp_degree_distribution()
How many features have each degree
vp_gini()
How unevenly a quantity is spread
vp_summary()
One row of numbers per model

Conflicts

vp_alternative_groups()
Groups of any features that all exclude each other (at most one per product)
vp_candidate_groups()
Mutually exclusive children of one parent: the alternative groups a feature model would declare
vp_colouring()
The features split into groups without conflicts
vp_conflict_cover()
The fewest 'at most one of' groups that state every conflict
vp_explain_conflict()
Why two features exclude each other
vp_explain_requires()
Why one feature requires another
vp_largest_compatible_set()
The most features without a conflict among them
vp_opposites()
Pairs of which every product has exactly one
vp_primitive_atleastone()
The at-least-one lines from which all others follow
vp_primitive_conflicts()
The conflicts from which all others follow
vp_requires_from_conflicts()
Requirements explained by a conflict and an at-least-one line
vp_twins()
Features that behave identically

Configuration and teams

vp_can_go_together()
Can these features be in one product? (a wish list)
vp_consequences()
What some decisions force
vp_count_graph_products()
How many products the graphs allow (small models)
vp_kernel()
The kernel: a small map for 'can these go together?'
vp_kernel_links()
The arrows and red lines of the kernel
vp_mig()
The modal implication graph: every implication between two decisions
vp_most_decisive()
The features whose selection decides the most
vp_pair()
The four combinations of two features: which are possible
vp_partial_configuration()
Is this mix of selected and left-out features possible?
vp_rounds()
A safe order for asking about features, in rounds
vp_split_after()
The independent parts of what is left after some decisions
vp_splitting_decisions()
Single decisions that split the model most, taken before the teams start
vp_team_links()
The links between features of different teams: where teams interfere
vp_team_moves()
Features with more links to another team than to their own
vp_team_order()
In which order teams decide, which decide together, which must agree
vp_teams()
How independent each team is: links inside and outside, features it decides alone

Testing

vp_combinations_to_cover()
How many combinations a t-wise sample must cover
vp_coverage()
How much of them a sample covers
vp_min_sample_size()
A lower bound on the size of any covering sample
vp_pick_sample()
A small covering sample chosen from given configurations
vp_sample_violations()
Configurations of a sample that break a link
vp_uncovered()
Which combinations a sample misses

Patterns and statistics

vp_baseline()
What a random model of the same shape would give
vp_communities()
Groups of closely linked features
vp_compare_groupings()
How alike two groupings are
vp_coreness()
How deep in the conflicts each feature sits
vp_cut_features()
Single features that hold two parts together
vp_feature_groups()
Features grouped by their measures
vp_independent_parts()
Parts of the model that no relationship ties together
vp_odd_ones()
Alike in conflicts, different in requirements
vp_power_law()
Does a degree distribution follow a power law?
vp_robustness()
How the skeleton falls apart when hubs are removed
vp_similar_features()
Features most alike in one graph
vp_triangle_significance()
Which kinds of triangle occur more, or less, often than by chance
vp_triangles()
The four kinds of triangle

Evolution

vp_attachment()
Where new features attach
vp_auc()
How good a ranking is (area under the curve)
vp_changed_links()
The links gained and lost
vp_co_change()
Features whose links change in the same steps
vp_community_history()
Do communities stay the same?
vp_compare()
What changed between two versions
vp_disruptions()
Steps that changed far more than usual
vp_edit_type()
Did a step restrict the model, relax it, or both?
vp_eras()
The history split into runs of alike versions
vp_feature_churn()
The features that changed most over a history (hotspots)
vp_feature_states()
The state of every feature in every version
vp_flip_flops()
Features that change state back and forth
vp_forecast_size()
Forecast the size of later versions
vp_growth()
How fast links grow with features
vp_history_apply()
Any measure, version by version
vp_history_changes()
What changed at every step
vp_history_sizes()
The size of every version
vp_hub_stability()
Are the hubs the same from version to version?
vp_interaction_changes()
Combinations of two features a step made possible or impossible (and the tests they touch)
vp_life_cycle()
How features move between variable, core, dead, absent
vp_link_lifetime()
How long new links last
vp_prediction_table()
One row per feature and version, for predictions
vp_rename()
Rename features of a model
vp_rename_candidates()
Features that were probably renamed
vp_ripple()
How many consequences each written change had
vp_state_moves()
Features that appeared, disappeared or changed status
vp_top_movers()
The features whose links changed most
vp_version_distance()
How far apart every two versions are

The Graphviz (DOT) source of a drawing
vp_dot_compare()
The Graphviz (DOT) source of a drawing of what changed
vp_plot()

vp_plot_compare()
